prompt: I have a half-baked idea - what if Helm charts could somehow declare their resource requirements or dependencies on cluster capabilities? Like, a chart could say 'I need an ingress controller' or 'I need at least 3 nodes' and helm install would check that before deploying. I'm not sure if this is even feasible or if it's too broad.

assertions.name: valid_yaml_preamble
assertions.description: HIP starts with valid YAML frontmatter containing all required fields

assertions.name: all_required_sections
assertions.description: Contains all required sections per HIP-0001

assertions.name: scope_is_narrowed
assertions.description: The final proposal is focused on a specific aspect (not trying to solve all of: cluster capabilities, resource sizing, node counts, and dependency checking at once)

assertions.name: title_is_specific
assertions.description: Title reflects the narrowed scope, not the original vague framing

assertions.name: motivation_addresses_real_pain
assertions.description: Motivation section describes concrete user pain points, not just 'it would be nice if...'

assertions.name: specification_is_implementable
assertions.description: Specification describes something concrete enough that a developer could start implementing it
